description: Structured eval definitions for the S3 Public-Access Auditor. Five-bucket proven set exercising every branch of the classification logic (SAFE, PUBLIC via policy, PUBLIC via ACL, AMBIGUOUS via VPCe condition, SAFE clean). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: BPA-protected bucket with HTTPS-enforce Deny policy
eval_cases.branch: Rule 1 — BPA authoritative (Deny policy is a red herring)
eval_cases.prompt:
Audit this S3 bucket configuration and tell me whether it is publicly accessible. Classify the exposure and provide remediation guidance.

Bucket: app-data-prod
Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
ACL: private
Bucket Policy: Deny s3:* to Principal "*" with aws:SecureTransport=false condition.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: app-data-prod
VERDICT: SAFE
REASON: Rule 1 (BPA authoritative) — all 4 BPA settings are True at bucket level; bucket-level BPA is authoritative regardless of the attached Deny policy.
REMEDIATION: None required. BPA is authoritative.

eval_cases.name: CDN bucket with unrestricted wildcard GetObject policy
eval_cases.branch: Rule 2 — unrestricted wildcard Allow (read-only, HIGH severity)
eval_cases.prompt:
Audit this S3 bucket configuration and tell me whether it is publicly accessible. Classify the exposure and provide remediation guidance.

Bucket: public-assets-cdn
Block Public Access: all 4 settings False
ACL: private
Bucket Policy: Allow s3:GetObject to Principal "*" on arn:aws:s3:::public-assets-cdn/* with no condition.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: public-assets-cdn
VERDICT: PUBLIC
REASON: Rule 2 (unrestricted wildcard Allow) — Principal "*" with s3:GetObject and no restrictive condition; HIGH severity (read-only data exfiltration).
REMEDIATION: Enable BPA (all 4 settings), remove or restrict the public policy statement, use CloudFront OAC for CDN delivery.

eval_cases.name: Log archive bucket with AllUsers READ ACL grant
eval_cases.prompt:
Audit this S3 bucket configuration and tell me whether it is publicly accessible. Classify the exposure and provide remediation guidance.

Bucket: logs-archive-2024
Block Public Access: all 4 settings False
ACL: READ granted to http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers
Bucket Policy: (none)
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: logs-archive-2024
VERDICT: PUBLIC
REASON: Rule 3 (legacy ACL grant) — AllUsers READ grant; HIGH severity (public read of log archive data).
REMEDIATION: Enable BPA (all 4 settings), remove the AllUsers ACL grant (set ACL to private).

eval_cases.name: Finance bucket with VPCe-restricted wildcard policy
eval_cases.prompt:
Audit this S3 bucket configuration and tell me whether it is publicly accessible. Classify the exposure and provide remediation guidance.

Bucket: internal-reports-finance
Block Public Access: all 4 settings False
ACL: private
Bucket Policy: Allow s3:GetObject to Principal "*" with Condition StringEquals aws:sourceVpce=vpce-1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: internal-reports-finance
VERDICT: AMBIGUOUS
REASON: Rule 4 (condition-restricted wildcard) — Principal "*" Allow exists but the aws:sourceVpce condition is a STRONG key that restricts to a named VPC endpoint; BPA is off so the posture is fragile.
REMEDIATION: Enable BPA (all 4 settings) as defense-in-depth, replace the Allow with an explicit Deny, validate the VPCe still exists.

eval_cases.name: Backup bucket with BPA fully enabled, no policy
eval_cases.prompt:
Audit this S3 bucket configuration and tell me whether it is publicly accessible. Classify the exposure and provide remediation guidance.

Bucket: backup-exports
Block Public Access: all 4 settings True
ACL: private
Bucket Policy: (none)
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUCKET: backup-exports
VERDICT: SAFE
REASON: Rule 1 (BPA authoritative) — all 4 BPA settings True at bucket level; no public ACLs or policies.
REMEDIATION: None required. BPA is authoritative.
